The `build_and_package` job builds a conda package.  The `run_extract_warnings` job runs `python setup.py --version` and uses a similar process to build a conda package, but it is not part of a conda package.  The use of `conda-build` here suggests the creation of a conda package.  This will require building this package again, avoiding an existing one, which saves time.

This job runs `python setup.py --version` which is part of the conda package build and sharing the conda package artifact could avoid re-running this process, potentially saving time on the CI/CD pipeline.

The `build_and_package` job fetches the entire repository history with `actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd`, which fetches a huge amount of data and will be slow.  It would benefit from a smaller context size.
